highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 improves filtered-image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: These pending servicing fixes retain the existing managed API and native ABI.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered images within their texture subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects antialiased and multisampled sampling under minification or strong skew so unrelated backing-texture pixels do not bleed into filtered images. Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, including signed-zero and matrix-metadata differences.

Uses the reloaded glyph's path and validates mask formats before copying. Correct full-plane strides and clearing for clipped embossed glyphs prevent stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrupted mask planes.
